name: Writing a Professional Email Opening
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on writing a professional email opening -- practice these key phrases out loud:
I hope this email finds you well.
I'm writing to follow up on our conversation from last week.
Thank you for reaching out -- happy to help.
I wanted to touch base regarding the upcoming deadline.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
